outcome_evidence: The oven door is initially open, with the rack and green dish visible (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). The robot approaches the door and lifts it toward the oven front (frames 65–81, image and left_ego_image). The door is visibly closed by frame 83 and remains closed as the gripper withdraws through frame 119 (image and left_ego_image). No failed attempt or unintended object displacement is visible.
